body.objective: Students will be able to discuss environmental issues.
successCriteria: I can discuss environmental and social issues in Mandarin
I can use 如果…就… for conditions and results
I can propose solutions and explain their effects
body.hook: China has some of the world's largest cities and has also become the biggest producer of solar panels and electric vehicles. Environmental issues are a major topic in Chinese media, and talking about them needs conditional sentences: 如果…就… rúguǒ... jiù...: "If..., then..."

study.title: 保护环境 Bǎohù huánjìng
study.question: How do I discuss environmental issues and solutions in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Issues: 空气污染 kōngqì wūrǎn (air pollution), 水污染 shuǐ wūrǎn (water pollution), 气候变化 qìhòu biànhuà (climate change), 塑料垃圾 sùliào lājī (plastic waste), 交通堵塞 jiāotōng dǔsè (traffic jams).
Solutions: 坐公共汽车 zuò gōnggòng qìchē (take the bus), 骑自行车 qí zìxíngchē (ride a bike), 节约用水 jiéyuē yòng shuǐ (save water), 回收 huíshōu (recycle), 用电动车 yòng diàndòngchē (use electric vehicles), 种树 zhòng shù (plant trees).
Grammar: 如果 + condition，(subject) 就 + result. 如果大家都骑自行车，空气就会更干净。Rúguǒ dàjiā dōu qí zìxíngchē, kōngqì jiù huì gèng gānjìng. = If everyone rides bikes, the air will be cleaner. Note: 就 goes after the subject of the second clause.
短文:
以前，北京的空气污染很严重。现在，政府鼓励人们用电动车和坐地铁，所以空气比以前好多了。我认为如果每个人都减少用塑料袋，环境就会更好。如果我们不保护环境，我们的孩子就会有很多问题。
Yǐqián, Běijīng de kōngqì wūrǎn hěn yánzhòng. Xiànzài, zhèngfǔ gǔlì rénmen yòng diàndòngchē hé zuò dìtiě, suǒyǐ kōngqì bǐ yǐqián hǎo duō le. Wǒ rènwéi rúguǒ měi ge rén dōu jiǎnshǎo yòng sùliàodài, huánjìng jiù huì gèng hǎo. Rúguǒ wǒmen bù bǎohù huánjìng, wǒmen de háizi jiù huì yǒu hěn duō wèntí.
Task: Choose an issue in Alberta or China and propose three solutions with 如果…就….
study.source: Original text written for this lesson.
steps: Propose solutions with conditions and results
discussion: How has Beijing's air changed and why?
Where does 就 go in a 如果 sentence?
What environmental issue matters most in Alberta?
Which solution is most realistic for your family?
study.product: Present a two-minute proposal in Mandarin on an environmental or social issue, with the problem, three solutions and four 如果…就… sentences.

examples.title: Condition
examples.problem: Say "If we recycle, there will be less garbage."
examples.answer: 如果我们回收，垃圾就会减少。

examples.title: Word order
examples.problem: Fix: 如果你骑自行车，就你会健康。
examples.answer: 如果你骑自行车，你就会很健康。

examples.title: Negative condition
examples.problem: Say "If we don't protect the environment, there will be problems."
examples.answer: 如果我们不保护环境，就会有很多问题。

examples.title: Reading
examples.problem: Why is Beijing's air better now?
examples.answer: The government encourages electric vehicles and the subway

practice.q: Translate: If it rains, I will take the bus.
practice.a: 如果下雨，我就坐公共汽车。

practice.q: Why is Beijing's air better than before?
practice.a: People use electric vehicles and the subway.

practice.q: What does the writer suggest about plastic bags?

practice.a: 骑自行车, 回收, 种树, 节约用水 (others).

practice.q: Where does 就 go in the result clause?
practice.a: After the subject, before the verb.

practice.q: What does the writer warn will happen if we don't protect the environment?
practice.a: Our children will have many problems.

practice.q: Write a 如果…就… sentence about an Alberta issue.
How does 社会 connect to environmental issues?
practice.a: Pollution and climate affect health, jobs and communities.

misconceptions: Using 如果 without a clear result
exitTicket: Write two 如果…就… sentences about the environment.
Name three environmental problems in Mandarin.

options: C) electric vehicles and the subway
items.answer: C) electric vehicles and the subway

items.q: "If everyone rides bikes, the air will be cleaner" is
options: A) 就大家骑自行车如果空气干净。
B) 如果大家都骑自行车，空气就会更干净。
C) 大家骑自行车如果就空气干净。
D) 如果空气干净，大家骑自行车。
items.answer: B) 如果大家都骑自行车，空气就会更干净。

items.q: In 如果你努力，你就会成功, 就 goes
options: D) after the subject of the second clause
items.answer: D) after the subject of the second clause

items.q: The writer says that without protecting the environment
options: B) our children will have many problems
items.answer: B) our children will have many problems

items.q: Name two solutions to pollution in Mandarin.
Write three 如果…就… sentences about the environment.

items.answer: The government encouraged electric vehicles and subway use.

items.q: Translate: If we save water, the environment will be better.
items.answer: 如果我们节约用水，环境就会更好。

items.q: Explain the word order of 如果…就… sentences.
items.answer: 如果 + condition, subject + 就 + result.

items.q: Propose a solution to an environmental issue in Alberta in Mandarin.
